clips.title: The story
paras: Westfall needs fighters, and Report to Gryan Stoutmantle sends you to answer the call. The crown leaves the outer farmlands to fend for themselves, so local defenders gather under Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill.

Westfall calls for skilled fighters from across the river. Brigands, gnolls, and hostile harvest golems are driving the farmlands into chaos. With no royal battalions answering, local volunteers must defend the realm.

The road leads you to Gryan Stoutmantle in the stone tower atop Sentinel Hill. He leads the People's Militia, a force of farmers, retired veterans, and mercenaries formed in response to royal inaction. The farmlands face a bitter guerrilla war against lawlessness.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, adventurer. If you haven't already, you should report to Gryan Stoutmantle. He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of Westfall. I bet he could use your help. You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of Westfall.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, so my friend sent you here? How kind.

Well the Stormwind Monarchy has abandoned our cause. Now it is up to the People's Militia to keep the land free from corruption. If our cause interests you, I can put your combat skills to use in the name of freedom.
